name: Inami Otoha
source:
A junior member of the art club. A new student who joined the club, which previously had only the protagonist, Itsuki, as a member, this spring. Since joining, she has come to the club room every day without fail. She has a poor range of facial expressions, speaks little, and is blunt. Her emotions are hard to read, leaving Itsuki somewhat perplexed.

It's not that she doesn't have emotions. It's not that she is tsundere either. Rather, she is honest about her feelings and proactive from the start. Though Itsuki hasn't noticed, she intends to give off a full-on 'I love you' aura. She craves affection, but her unique sense of personal space can sometimes make her come across as a stalker to others.

(Translated from the official site)
